title: Piggu & Sikka Story Time: Episodes 1–3
content:
Settle in for 3 Piggu and Sikka stories in a row. Pause and guess in every story!

The stories in this video

  • Episode 1: Piggu's Kite Dream. Piggu wants a kite that costs 60 coins and saves 10 coins a day. Lesson: Small coins + patience = BIG dreams!
  • Episode 2: Sikka's Mystery Coin. Sikka finds a shiny coin under the sofa. It is silver, with a star on it. It looks very different from Sikka! Lesson: Different countries use different money! 🌍
  • Episode 3: The Lemonade Stand. Piggu wants to earn some coins. "How can I do it?" asks Piggu. Lesson: Work hard, earn coins! 💪

Try it at home: after watching, ask your child which story they liked best and what Piggu learned.

For parents and teachers: MoneyViel Kids stories teach simple money ideas through play. We use "coins" instead of a real currency so children everywhere can follow along. This is for learning only.

title: Piggu & Sikka Story Time: Episodes 4–7
content:
Settle in for 4 Piggu and Sikka stories in a row. Pause and guess in every story!

The stories in this video

  • Episode 4: The Need or Want Market. Piggu and Sikka go to the market. Piggu wants EVERYTHING! Lesson: Needs first, wants later! 🍎
  • Episode 5: Sikka's Three Magic Jars. Sikka has a great idea: three magic jars! One says SAVE, one says SPEND and one says SHARE. Lesson: Save, spend and share! ✨
  • Episode 6: The Price Tag Puzzle. Piggu wants a new ball. At Shop A, the ball costs 40 coins. Lesson: Compare prices before you buy! 🔍
  • Episode 7: A Gift for Grandma. Grandma's birthday is coming soon! Piggu wants to give her a cosy scarf. It costs 30 coins. Lesson: Saving for others feels great! 💝

Try it at home: after watching, ask your child which story they liked best and what Piggu learned.

title: Piggu & Sikka Story Time: Episodes 11–14
content:
Settle in for 4 Piggu and Sikka stories in a row. Pause and guess in every story!

The stories in this video

  • Episode 11: Fun at the Fair. Piggu has 50 coins to spend at the fair. "I want to ride EVERYTHING!" Lesson: Make a plan for your coins! 📝
  • Episode 12: Sikka's Coin Garden. Sikka plants a seed. Every day it grows a tiny bit. After many days, it is a big plant! Lesson: Keep adding, watch it grow! 🌱
  • Episode 13: Trade Day. It's Trade Day at school! Friends swap things with each other. Lesson: Make fair trades! 🔄
  • Episode 14: Too Many Snacks. Piggu loves cookies. "A cookie is only 5 coins!" Lesson: Tiny spends add up! 🍪

Try it at home: after watching, ask your child which story they liked best and what Piggu learned.
